storyCards.fact:
Bruno Mars's "Marry You" reached #85 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Marry You" is a song by American singer and songwriter Bruno Mars from his debut studio album, Doo-Wops & Hooligans (2010).

The song peaked at #85 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 9 weeks on the chart.

Marry You was released in 2010.
